description: The figure is a pie chart showing the distribution of data sources in a combined dataset, with 13 labeled slices. The largest slice is labeled “NQ” and is colored medium blue at about 31.3%. Other slices include “FEVER” (teal/cyan, ~16.7%), “SNLI” (orange, ~15.4%), “VITAMINC” (light teal, ~13.0%), and “MULTINLI” (salmon/pink, ~11.3%). Smaller slices are “ANLI” (green, ~4.6%), “FACTCC” (yellow, ~2.6%), “ENTFA” (light gray, ~1.8%), “SUMHUL” (very light blue, ~1.6%), “SCITAIL” (light green, ~1.2%), “PUBHEALTH” (pale yellow, ~0.5%), “SCIFACT” (very light/near-white, ~0.1%), and “TIFC” (a very thin sliver near the bottom, percentage not clearly legible in the image). Labels with percentages are placed outside the pie with leader lines, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
